changes.detail: Compulsory Mathematics updated with revised taxation slabs and new chapters on financial literacy.
New Law Stream introduced with Legal System of Nepal and Constitutional Law subjects.
Mathematics weightage increased to 40 marks. New questions from AP/GP and matrices/determinants sections added.
Medical Education Commission introduced unified marking format for all sub-exams.
Basic Computer Science section updated with new topics on Cloud Computing and Cybersecurity basics.
Science stream chemistry syllabus restructured with organic chemistry moved to later units.
TU BCA semester 3 now includes Web Technologies as compulsory instead of elective.
Computer basics section expanded with questions on e-governance and digital Nepal framework.
Removed questions from Botany section that were erroneously included in 2023 paper.
Science and Technology subject received new chapters on Space Science and Nanotechnology.
PU launched new BSc CSIT program with credit-based semester system.
Primary level teacher exam syllabus updated with Inclusive Education and ICT in Education topics.
BSc Nursing entrance now includes General Knowledge Nepal section worth 20 marks.
TU BBS shifted to semester system from annual system starting Year 1.
